purpose: Fast outcome-known regression benchmark for ligand preparation and raw Vina ranking

preparation.ligands: AutoDockTools prepare_ligand4.py; preserve supplied DUD2 state; fail closed

docking.ranking: lowest finite raw Vina score ascending

published_reference.citation: Empereur-Mot et al., Journal of Cheminformatics 7:52 (2015)
published_reference.comparison_rule: Pipeline values must round to the published two-decimal values

scientific_scope.comparison_class: same target, PDB, DUD2 records, metric, and ranking direction; accelerated engine and incompletely reported publication preparation prevent exact full-protocol equivalence
scientific_scope.forbidden_use: untouched validation or evidence that a tuned ranking generalizes
